name: MT200 to pacs.009 Precondition Validation
description: Validates MT200 messages against CBPR+ requirements for FI Transfer for Own Account before transformation to pacs.009.001.08

tasks.name: Validate No Rejection or Return Indicators
tasks.description: Ensures field 72 does not start with /REJT/ or /RETN/ codes which are not allowed in CBPR+ MT200 transformation

tasks.name: Validate UETR Presence
tasks.description: Ensures UETR (Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference) is present in block 3 as mandatory for CBPR+ pacs.009

tasks.name: Validate Core Compatibility
tasks.description: Validates MT200 message is compatible with CORE workflow for FI Transfer for Own Account
